Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misinterpreted the Wikipedia information after clicking “Ghost Rider,” conflating the 1949 Magazine Enterprises western character with the Marvel Comics motorcycle superhero that the Suicide song references. This incorrect attribution (ignoring the song’s clear motorcycle imagery and common sourcing to Marvel) led the Planner to finalize the wrong brand.
